description: This file implements a Kubernetes controller for managing ServiceAccount objects within namespaces, ensuring default service accounts exist, and handling namespace and service account events.

classes.name: ServiceAccountsControllerOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for the ServiceAccountsController, including lists of service accounts to ensure and resync intervals.

classes.name: ServiceAccountsController
classes.description: Controller managing ServiceAccount objects within Kubernetes namespaces, ensuring default accounts exist and handling related events.

methods.name: DefaultServiceAccountsControllerOptions
methods.description: Returns default options for creating a ServiceAccountsController, including a default 'default' service account.

methods.name: NewServiceAccountsController
methods.description: Constructs and returns a new ServiceAccountsController with provided informers, client, logger, and options.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Starts the controller, runs worker goroutines, and manages shutdown.

methods.name: serviceAccountDeleted
methods.description: Handles deletion of a ServiceAccount by scheduling namespace reconciliation.

methods.name: namespaceAdded
methods.description: Handles addition of a namespace by scheduling it for processing.

methods.name: namespaceUpdated
methods.description: Handles updates to a namespace by scheduling it for processing.

methods.name: runWorker
methods.description: Processes items from the work queue until shutdown.

methods.name: processNextWorkItem
methods.description: Processes a single item from the work queue, handling errors and retries.

methods.name: syncNamespace
methods.description: Ensures default service accounts exist in the specified namespace, creating them if necessary.
